question: Which of the following teams was the runner-up of the 18th Edition of the Indian Premier League in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab Kings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **18th Edition** of the **Indian Premier League (IPL)** was conducted in the year **2025**, featuring a total of ten franchise teams competing for the prestigious trophy.
 
• **Punjab Kings** (PBKS) emerged as the **runner-up** of the **2025** season after a highly competitive final match. ***Hence, the correct answer is Punjab Kings.***
 
• **Chennai Super Kings** (Option 1) has historically been one of the most successful teams in the league with multiple titles, but they did not finish as the runner-up in the **18th edition**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
• **Sunrisers Hyderabad** (Option 2), who were the runners-up in the **2024** (17th) edition, did not secure the second position in **2025**. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.***
